A Boston University club for meeting people in person. Offline, on purpose.

01 / What we do

Community, offline.

CDS Offline is a student organization dedicated to fostering community by forging connections through offline activities. Many students, especially in computer science and data science, spend much of their day online.

Our goal is to create welcoming opportunities for students to connect face-to-face, step away from their screens, and build community together.
